requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-2624-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding an additional {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1957-4050-4210--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

907-1315-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

1115-2034-3755-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2232-7827-7828-7835.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7828-7835.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-2665.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-2665.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirror Image and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-2665.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

457-1409-5359.description:
Activate Threefold Thunderhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Threefold Thunderhulk
Resolve the Threefold Thunderhulk trigger, creating three artifact tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Threefold Thunderhulk and another artifact, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-5359.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

372-1922-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-7487.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
1115-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7235.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

777-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3944-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

147-2034-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2034-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

654-4629-6712.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sonic triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that is dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasure(s).
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
654-4629-6712.notes: It is strongly recommended to perform this combo once you have the highest life total to end the game. It is, however, not a requirement.

1170-1770-2733-5954-6664.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

719-1789-4050-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
719-1789-4050-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

565-2450-4600-6203.manaNeeded: {2}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
565-2450-4600-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Throne of Eldraine.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as its color as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
565-2450-4600-6203.notes: Once you have infinite mana to cast Whim of Volrath, you can either name different colors, draw cards instead, and/or target other permanents.

586-5147-5626-5687.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

656-4934-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Ugin's Conjurant from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1624-2928-3646-4827.manaNeeded: {8}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-2928-3646-4827.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Strovald by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving Evra base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

3363-4659-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
3363-4659-5131.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The One Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Cast The One Ring from your graveyard by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

205-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Azor.
Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

122-1496-1734-2034.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding {C}{C}.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.

77-1355-3953-5275.notablePrerequisites:
Triclopean Sight attached to Sanctum Weaver.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three enchantments.
77-1355-3953-5275.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Triclopean Sight.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling Triclopean Sight from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Triclopean Sight from exile by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Sanctum Weaver.
Triclopean Sight enters the battlefield, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

494-1745.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
494-1745.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be used to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat step 1 until you have one life.
Cast Ribbons from your graveyard for its aftermath cost by paying {B}{B} and by paying all available {C}.
Resolve Riboons, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the colorless mana paid this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1283-4404-4499.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1806-1986-2034-2302.notablePrerequisites: Painter's Servant namaing a color of your choice.
1806-1986-2034-2302.description:
Sacrifice Eternal Scourge to Ashnod's Altar adding {C}{C}.
Activate Titans' Nest, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge using the 3 mana produced.
Repeat for infinite ETB, LTB, and storm.
